City of Chicago

                            Office of the City Clerk
                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 3/23/2022
Sponsor(s):                   Waguespack (32)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 7-1 at 2550 N Milwaukee
                              Ave and 3131 W Logan Blvd
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                      ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO;

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all ofthe B3-3,
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 7-1 in the
area bound by;

      West Logan Boulevard; North Milwaukee Avenue; the alley next southeast of West
      Logan Boulevard and perpendicular to North Milwaukee Avenue; a northwesterly line
      starting from a point 72.71 south ofthe intersection ofthe previously stated alley and
      North Milwaukee Avenue and ending at a point 196.2 feet northwest along the north
      Chicago Transit Authority Right-of-Way line; a southwesteriy line 29 feet from the
      previously stated point to a line 48.73 feet south of West Logan Boulevard; a line 48.73
      feet south of and parallel to West Logan Boulevard; a line 94.53 feet west of the
      intersection of West Logan Boulevard and North Milwaukee Avenue as measured along
      the southerly line of West Logan Boulevard,

to those of a POS-2, Parks and Open Space District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          Scott Waguespac

                                                          Alderman, 32"" Ward




Common Address:
2550 N. Milwaukee
3131 W. Logan Boulevard
